candidates.summary: altitude: the "gnoweb alone" case pins wantRealms as empty because fakeRepo omits every seed realm, so BuildPlan's gnowebSeedRealms branch (plan.go:263-270) never appends in any test
candidates.failure_scenario: The seed-realm append is what every gnoweb-only preview runs in CI: it turns an empty realm list into the four pages of gnowebSeedRealms, and those four realms are what the reviewer clicks. The fixture instead pins the opposite outcome with the comment "the seed realms do not exist in the fake repo", so `go test -coverprofile` shows `plan.go:265.51,267.5 1 0` — the `plan.Realms = append(plan.Realms, r)` body never executes. Nothing in the suite covers the two properties that branch decides: that a seed is skipped when pkgs[r] is nil, and that seeds are appended after the maxRealms cap is applied, so a capped gnoweb+realms PR renders maxRealms+4. Deeper form: give fakeRepo one gnowebSeedRealms entry (gno.land/r/gnoland/home) and assert it appears in the "gnoweb alone" case, rather than documenting its absence.
